coordinates: PDF points, origin top-left, y grows downward. Underscore run or drawn rule: its x extent, from 14 pt above the line to 1.5 pt under it. Cell or box: its drawn edges. Tick box: the printed square. Picture pages: the picture's pixels through the page's drawing matrix.

signing.kind: the investor (and a joint owner) sign on page 5; the issuer accepts on page 6; the custodian completes its information block for custodial accounts

sure_per_page.2: fairly sure: row cells split at captions; box glyphs printed as a diaeresis
sure_per_page.5: sure: Title: has no printed line
sure_per_page.6: sure: Dated: has no printed line

2: table headings (Non-Custodial Ownership, Custodial Ownership) and section heading rows
